Description.value: Beta. Required: install together with 0-ArmoryUnbound in an Undead Legacy 2.7 game. Adds the Gunsmith Bench to UL's research tree and workbench, perk-part recipes, perk parts and starter skins in loot and at traders, corrupted perk parts in hardened chests, perk-part upgrades at UL's Maintenance Station, and UL's look for the Gunsmith panel.
